outcomes.E3: p < 0.001, b < c, upper CI bound < 0: stop, read rule 3

rules.1: lower CI bound of (B_70 - C_70) > 0: stage 1 helps at 70 % of the demos
rules.2: CI contains 0: no effect seen; not 'egocentric does not help'
rules.3: upper CI bound < 0: B_70 worse than C_70, a valid negative result
rules.4: McNemar p reported beside rules 1-3; a disagreement is reported
rules.f: B_70 vs C_ALL, margin 0.10: not inferior if lower bound > -0.10, inferior if upper bound < -0.10, else unclear; 'egocentric compensates the cut demos' only if (f) not inferior AND rule 1
rules.g: C_70 vs C_ALL, same margin: if not inferior, the 30 % cut is not a bottleneck and (f) owes nothing to egocentric
rules.b: each run: levels 1-2 pooled vs 0.80 (Wilson 95 %: met if lower >= 0.80, not met if upper < 0.80, else unclear); levels 1 and 2 apart vs 0.70
